tools.name: bill_status
tools.description: Shows where one UK bill is now: its current stage and house with sitting dates, whether it has become an Act, been withdrawn or defeated, its long title and its sponsoring members and departments. Answers "where is the X bill now", "has it passed" and "who introduced it". Source: UK Parliament Bills

tools.description: Lists every stage a UK bill has been through or has scheduled, in order, with the house and each sitting date: first and second reading, committee, report, third reading, Lords stages, consideration of amendments, Royal Assent. tools.name: bill_documents
tools.description: Lists the documents published for a UK bill, newest first: bill texts, explanatory notes, amendment papers, impact assessments, delegated powers memoranda and committee reports, with direct PDF and web links. For lawyers and policy staff after the latest bill text or notes. Source: UK Parliament Bil

tools.name: bill_amendments
tools.description: Lists the amendments tabled at one stage of a UK bill, with the clause or schedule targeted, the amendment wording, its sponsors and the decision recorded (agreed, negatived, withdrawn, not moved). For public affairs teams and campaigners tracking whether an amendment got through. Source: UK Parliam

tools.name: bills_recently_updated
tools.description: Lists the UK Parliament bills whose records changed most recently, with current stage, house, upcoming or latest sitting dates and status. tools.name: acts_recent_royal_assent
